description: Bounded transitive dependency graph of an npm package version: every node with the declared range, the resolved version (highest published version satisfying the range, as a fresh install without a lockfile would pick), depth, parent, deprecation, and the OSV advisories that match it. Limits are enforced and reported: nothing is silently cut. Price: 0.01 USDC per call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base or Solana, no account, no API key); invalid input is refused before payment and a failed run is never charged. Without a payment the tool returns the x402 PaymentRequired. How to call it: get_example {"tool":"deps_get_dependency_tree"}. Same tool over HTTP: https://yruz.one/api/deps/tree?name=express&depth=2
name: deps_get_dependency_tree
title: YRUZ DependencyPulse Dependency Tree (0.01 USDC)
